Major AI Developments.title: IIIT-H launches 3-month certificate course on Engineering Agentic AI Systems
Major AI Developments.summary: IIIT-H has launched a 3-month certificate course on Engineering Agentic AI Systems. The course is part of the institution's efforts to advance innovation and research in AI. This initiative aims to equip students with the skills to design and develop intelligent systems.

Major AI Developments.title: How Tagbin turned an early bet on AR, VR, and AI into a Rs 250 Cr government-tech powerhouse
Major AI Developments.summary: Tagbin, founded in 2013 by three IIT Roorkee graduates, utilizes AI and immersive technologies like AR, VR, and holograms to aid governments in decision-making and create engaging public experiences. The company has grown into a significant government-tech entity, valued at Rs 250 Cr. Tagbin's innovative approach helps museums, exhibitions, and public spaces create interactive experiences.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bucketlistt raises pre-seed funding to scale experience tourism platform
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bucketlistt, a curated experiences marketplace, has raised Rs 1.07 crore in pre-seed funding at a valuation of Rs 10.07 crore from angel investors. The startup, founded in 2025, offers a platform for adventure, cultural, and spiritual experiences across India. Bucketlistt also operates OkGhumo, an ERP and CRM platform for experience operators to manage their businesses.
